scenarios.description: The document uses the term "Index Administrator" and treats it as having the meaning defined in Section "Introduction".
The document uses "Index Administrator" but says its meaning is defined in Section "Definitions" instead of Section "Introduction".
The document says "Index Administrator" has a meaning defined in Section "Introduction" and also says no other section may define that term.
Before Section "Introduction" appears, the document already uses "Index Administrator" as if its meaning were fixed, and only later states the definition in Section "Introduction".
